items.title: Pay vet invoice
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 17.04.2026. Payment term is 14 days net 'ab Rechnungsdatum'. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (17.04.2026) is not counted, so the period starts on 18.04.2026. Counting 14 days forward, the period ends on 01.05.2026 (§188 Abs.1 BGB). 01.05.2026 is a Friday and a statutory public holiday (Tag der Arbeit) in Nordrhein-Westfalen, and 02.-03.05.2026 fall on the following Saturday/Sunday. Under §193 BGB, since the last day of the period is a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, the deadline is extended to the next business day, which is Monday 04.05.2026.
